basis: studio-series-audit-plan.json "missing" (96 TFWiki Hasbro releases with no catalog row)
rules: One row per retail product; multipacks are a single row (no set members), so no pack member duplicates an existing single row.
releaseDate is year-only (TFWiki gives no month) and tagged date-precision:year.

sku, imageUrl and msrp only where sourced (sku = EAN confirmed by 2+ sources; image = retailer listing whose filename carries that EAN; msrp = actionfigure411 US retail). Otherwise sku/image omitted, msrp 0.
Cancelled TFWiki entries are skipped; entries whose EAN/product code already sits on an existing (unsure) row are skipped to avoid a duplicate.
2027 announcements use source tfwiki-studio-series-announce (announcement feed for the future-date guard).
